title: Transit: articles table never populated; GC and tracking non-functional
description: transit/peering/pipeline.rs:227-237: comment explicitly states articles are NOT recorded in the articles table. GC (retention/gc_candidates.rs) queries this table and returns nothing. Admin stats show 0 articles. The retention policy engine is fully implemented but inert. The comment warns that when recording is added, ingest timestamp MUST be SystemTime::now() not the article Date header, but this invariant is unenforced by types. Fix: add the migration, implement the insert with a system-clock ingest timestamp, and add a compile-time check that the timestamp source is correct.
